title: GTA-Inspired NTE Open World Gets Tycoon Update
description: As GTA6 approaches, Hotta Studio's anime-inspired open world NTE prepares a major 11th November update featuring city logistics and new characters.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Bridging the Gap to GTA6: NTE's Major Tycoon Update

While the real *GTA6* may be right around the corner and dominating discussions across the gaming community, players are constantly looking for ways to stay occupied in the meantime. According to a recent report by gaming outlet Push Square, Hotta Studio’s anime-inspired open world game NTE is stepping up to provide just that with a significant upcoming update scheduled for **11th November**.

## What to Expect in the November 11th Update

As has become customary for Heathereau, there is a lot to look forward to in this patch. The standout feature of this update is a brand-new mode that allows players to manage city logistics, effectively bringing full-blown tycoon-style management into an open-world environment.

In addition to the city logistics management mode, the update brings several other additions:
- **Two new characters** to expand the roster.
- **New story quests** to advance the narrative.
- **Additional features** designed to keep players engaged while waiting for major industry heavyweights like *GTA6*.

## Editor's Take
While nothing quite matches the monumental anticipation surrounding *GTA6*, developer support through substantial content drops like NTE's upcoming tycoon update is a welcome distraction. For fans of open-world exploration looking for a mix of management mechanics and new quests, the 11th November update offers a great way to pass the time.
